 DeviceChain - Installing - kind-devicechain
 Help - Install progress
 
 l           logs
 Enter       exit
 ?/F1        help
 
 The run is over, and nothing is running while this screen
 is open. Leaving it never changes dcctl's exit status, and
 dcctl prints a short summary when it exits. l opens the
 log pane; while it is open PgUp and PgDn scroll it, and f
 follows it again.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Esc close help
